errors.text_span: Цветовете са кодирани според легендата в горния десен ъгъл.
errors.evidence: Легендата и цветовете in the figure do not match the machine description's implied ordering: the chart has Spain blue, France orange, China/continental gray, Italy yellow, Turkey light blue, USA green, and Argentina dark blue; the description later also misstates the order by comparing China and Italy as third and fourth while the reference indicates France is the second-highest and China/continental is the third.

errors.text_span: Испания и Франция имат най-високите стойности през целия период, като Испания обикновено е с най-висок стълб, следвана от Франция, докато Китай (континентален) и Италия са на трето и четвърто място
errors.evidence: The figure shows France is not the second-highest by color/series order wording alone, but the main factual issue is that the description gives an incorrect ranking emphasis: the highest series is Spain, followed by China/continental and Italy in the middle, while France is lower than Spain but not described accurately relative to the plotted series arrangement in the reference. The description also omits that the values are constant across years.
The description does not mention that the bars are grouped by year and that all series are essentially flat/constant across 2013–2022, which the reference highlights as an important visual feature.
